scope: Fixed-camera visible counting and continuous observed dwell; offline local-video feasibility prototype.

actual_host.note: Actual host recorded. A skipped CoreML test is not a CoreML hardware verification.

ci: Windows/Linux/macOS arm64 workflow configured; not executed on GitHub for this release.
limitations: Positive learned-model regression repeats a still image before blank frames; not motion, occlusion or surveillance accuracy.
Latency reports use synthetic RGB on a shared desktop, exclude decode/tracking/rules, and do not establish idle-device rankings.
State soak traces Python allocations only, not sustained decoded-video RSS/VRAM.
Actual AMD and M1 hardware tests, real model CoreML compatibility, labeled-camera accuracy and multi-hour deployment remain pending.
runtime_network: No ongoing LLM calls, API keys or automatic model downloads.

video_lab.note: Exploratory video test; sparse single-reviewer count annotations, not event accuracy certification.
